title: Quote Lock
description: Stops paying a re-quoted price you never saw: it shows a held FX, swap or fare quote draining, fetches a fresh one when the hold ends (skew-proof with validFor), rolls the amount from old to new with the difference called out, turns a worse-than-tolerance price into an explicit Accept step by morphing the Pay button in place, re-quotes a Pay pressed in the hold's last seconds, keeps the amount in the Pay label, and ignores stale responses and double presses.
stops: Paid a re-quoted price I never saw
